urdu: بنگلہ دیش کے خلاف پاکستان قومی خواتین کرکٹ ٹیم نے مارچ 2014ء میں کتنی ون ڈے میچز جیتے تھے؟
english: How many One Day matches did the Pakistan national women's cricket team win against Bangladesh in March 2014?
roman_1: Bangladesh ke khilaf Pakistan qaumi khawateen cricket team ne March 2014 mein kitni One Day matches jeete the?
roman_2: Bangladesh ke muqable mein Pakistan women cricket team ne March 2014 mein kitni ODI jeeti thi?
roman_3: Bangladesh ke against Pakistan khawateen cricket team ne March 2014 mein kitnay One Day matches jeetay thay?
